text.p: COMMISSION DECISION of 1 July 1997 amending Commission Decision 97/252/EC drawing up provisional lists of third country establishments from which the Member States authorize imports of milk and milk-based products for human consumption (Text with EEA relevance) (97/480/EC) END OF DOCUMENT.
